newsitem.title: USA: Japan seeks U.S., Canada and Australian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Japan seeks U.S., Canada and Australian wheat.

text.p: The Japanese Food Agency will tender Tuesday night for a total of 80,000 tonnes U.S. wheat, 40,000 tonnes Canadian wheat and 17,000 tonnes Australian prime hard wheat, U.S.-based Japanese export firms said.
The U.S. wheat would include 40,000 tonnes western white wheat, 20,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat and 20,000 tonnes hard red winter wheat, 13 percent protein content.
The Canadian wheat would include 20,000 tonnes spring wheat, 5,000 tonnes western red spring and 15,000 durum.
Japan will also seek 3,000 tonnes Canadian western six-row barley, 17,000 tonnes Canadian feed barley and 20,000 tonnes Australian feed barley.
Shipment for all commodities was slated for December 1-January 10.
